scripts.build: bunx --bun --no-install tsc --noEmit && bunx --bun --no-install agent-tool --repo ../.. images build favicons --out packages/client/public && bunx --bun --no-install vite build
scripts.deploy: bun --bun run build && bunx --bun --no-install wrangler deploy
scripts.dev: bunx --bun --no-install agent-tool --repo ../.. images build favicons --out packages/client/public && bunx --bun --no-install vite
scripts.build:mobile: bunx --bun --no-install tsc --noEmit && bunx --bun --no-install agent-tool --repo ../.. images build favicons --out packages/client/public && bunx --bun --no-install vite build --mode mobile
scripts.mobile:sync: bun run build:mobile && bunx --bun --no-install agent-tool --repo ../.. images build native && bun scripts/prepareMobile.ts && bunx --bun --no-install cap sync
scripts.mobile:ios: bun run mobile:sync && bunx --bun --no-install cap open ios
scripts.mobile:android: bun run mobile:sync && bunx --bun --no-install cap open android
